# strided-rs v0.4.8

## New

- **`map_into_uninit_with_kernel` ([#294](https://github.com/tensor4all/strided-rs/pull/294)).**
  A map entry point that offers a caller's vectorized kernel the flat runs this crate already
  knows about: the whole buffer when a sequential operation sees a shared contiguous layout, and
  one block at a time on the parallel path. Runs whose strides are not both 1 never reach it, and
  a kernel that declines a run hands that run back to the scalar closure. It exists because a
  caller that owns vector kernels otherwise has to rebuild the layout logic — and the threading
  decision — in order to reach them; doing that from outside short-circuits `map_into`, which
  silently drops the operation to a single thread. `map_into` and every other entry point are
  unchanged and monomorphize exactly as before, because the kernel travels as a parameter they
  instantiate as `NoKernel`.

## Compatibility

No public API changes to existing items; the release is source compatible with 0.4.7.

**Full comparison:** https://github.com/tensor4all/strided-rs/compare/v0.4.7...v0.4.8
